items.quote: In Indian market, '23-'24 was marked by erratic weather patterns and lower-than-average rainfall due to the El Nino factors. This impacted demand for agrochemicals in the Kharif season. And lower levels of water in the reservoirs further compounded these challenges in Rabi season as well.

items.statement: FY24 gross margin improved on full-year basis via procurement efficiencies, optimal pricing, and fixed cost control
items.quote: Our gross margin showed improvement on a full year basis, achieved through procurement efficiencies, optimal product pricing strategies and stringent cost control measures for fixed overheads.

items.statement: Net working capital days reduced by 33 days YoY to March 2024 due to lower inventory and receivable days and higher payable days
items.quote: In terms of overall net working capital base, there has been a deduction of 33 days as on March '24, as to that of March '23, mainly on account of decrease in inventory days and receivable days and increase in payable days.

items.statement: Two Make in India projects started commercial production in FY24; ramp-up expected in FY25; Dahej expansion under evaluation with environment clearance expected by end of calendar year
items.quote: In FY 2021, we had unveiled our intention to allocate 1.2 million towards to 2 'Make in India' initiatives for setting up 2 projects. Both these projects have started commercial level production. Some revenue were generated in the current financial year FY '23-'24. Ramp-up in the volume and revenue from these plants is expected from financial year '24-'25.

items.statement: Bhavnagar plant at full production, expecting 100% capacity export in FY25; Tarapur plant ready but revenue delayed to FY26 due to affiliate inventory; Dahej clearance expected by year-end
items.quote: As far as our capex on the Bhavnagar plant is concerned, there is full production and we expect that, I think in the last year, we had got -- we sold around 40% or 50% of our capacity we could export but in the current season means current year, we are expecting that 100% of our production capacity will be exported out as far as Bhavnagar plant is concerned.

items.statement: Q4 gross margin 41.7% up 1042 bps YoY and 199 bps QoQ due to quick high-cost inventory liquidation by August and lower raw material purchases in Q3-Q4
items.quote: First of all, I think the product mix, of course, is an important part, which was very good in Q3. Secondly, I think we -- at our company, what we could do very quickly was ramping up of liquidation of high-cost inventory. So I think by the month of August end, we had wiped off our high-cost inventory.

items.statement: FY25 focus on volume recovery not revenue matching; prices down 25-30% in generics, ~2% in specialty; no further price cuts intended unless competition forces
items.quote: We want to see how much of the volumes of each product we can increase in this coming year because we only can achieve the turnover of last year level if we increase the volumes because we are selling the products not at a comparable price as last year.

items.statement: Export recovery expected but timing unclear; domestic revival faster due to monsoon forecast; export order positions showing stability
items.quote: What we have observed Prashant, is that we see a recovery for sure. But whether this recovery is how much percentage is not clear. We are more clear that because of the rain forecast, et cetera, the domestic market will revive very quickly.

items.statement: FY24 revenue mix: Domestic 80%, Exports 20% (down from 25%); Insecticides 41%, Herbicides 22%, PGR 10%, Fungicides 8%
items.quote: In FY '23-'24, domestic agrochemical revenue has contributed about 80% of our overall revenue with export contributing the rest. In FY '23-'24, Insecticides contributed about 41% of total revenue while Herbicide, Plant Growth Regulators (PGR) and Fungicides contributing about 22%, 10% and 8% of total revenue, respectively.

items.statement: Barrix acquired 15 Dec 2023; consolidated for 105 days in Q4 FY24 with INR 10-12 crore sales; pheromones business expected strong growth
items.quote: So it has been just 105 days since they are part of Sumitomo. So in the overall numbers, I think the sales is not material right now. And we are expecting this sector and overall the positioning the company has and the very good products, they are expecting very good growth year-on-year basis and in the overall numbers, I think in terms of the sales, it is in the range of about INR10 crores to INR

items.statement: Launched 6 new proprietary products in FY24 (3 herbicides, 1 insecticide, 2 fungicides); focus on ramping sales in coming quarters
items.quote: We launched several new proprietary products aimed at diversifying our product portfolio and meeting evolving market demands. We launched 3 herbicides, 1 insecticide and 2 fungicides in FY '24.

items.statement: Export split approximately 60-40 between group companies and third parties; group companies reducing inventories per SCC Japan directives
items.quote: Probably 60-40, 60 would be. More approximately equal between group companies and outside.

items.statement: SCC Japan delaying Dahej project to avoid commoditized molecules; reviewing products carefully for mid-to-long term margin protection
items.quote: So we have to be very careful to choose the right molecule, what kind of products we should manufacture in the very important facility in India. If we make a mistake and then that molecule is going to be commoditized in such a case cost of competitiveness is why kind of in the tough position, I mean, the competition with the other players, that's huge, downward price pressure, that's huge.

items.statement: Dahej plant environment clearance application submitted; expected by end of calendar year; product package under parent company review
items.quote: As far as Dahej plant is concerned, we are -- our application for environment clearance has already been submitted. We expect that we should get the clearance by end of this calendar year.

items.statement: LatAm (Brazil) demand hit by adverse weather and excess supply causing price erosion; recovery expected as conditions stabilize
items.quote: LatAm market, particularly Brazil, experienced adverse weather conditions that significantly affected agricultural productivity. Unpredictable weather patterns, including droughts and excessive rains, led to reduction of crop yields, thereby decreasing the demand for agrochemical products.

items.statement: Invested in expanding strategic functions (marketing, demand generation, product development, regulatory, patents, exports) over past 2-3 years; some initiatives stabilized, others near-term results
items.quote: Over the past 2, 3 years, we have made significant investments in expanding strategic functions such as marketing, demand generation, product development, regulatory affairs, patents and exports. Some of these initiatives have already stabilized and started contributing growth, while others are expected to show results in the near future.

items.statement: Monsoon failure or geopolitical supply chain disruption could cause price volatility; high-cost inventory in channel remains uncertainty
items.quote: So unless and until something drastically goes wrong in terms of monsoon or in terms of pricing, again, due to geopolitical reasons, if the entire supply chain is affected. If something of that sort happens, we may see some price volatility but as of today, we feel that it is quite stable.

items.statement: Cash and cash equivalents INR 1,207 crores as on 31 March 2024 after interim dividend payment
items.quote: Cash and cash equivalents as on 31st March '24 stood at INR1,207 crores (after payment of interim dividend).

items.statement: Management expects 12-15% domestic volume growth in FY25 to offset price declines and grow new products
items.quote: So overall, I'm looking at somewhere around 12% to 15% volume.

items.statement: New product launches target 8-10% revenue contribution in FY25 assuming normal season
items.quote: Our target is at least not target, I would say our aspiration would be somewhere between 8% to 10%.

items.statement: Next capex cycle estimated at INR250-300 crores to start, funded from internal accruals
items.quote: And the next capital cycle should be in the range of INR250 crores to INR300 crores but we will at least prefer to start with.

items.statement: FY25 maintenance and other capex planned at INR53 crores including INR25 crores for green energy
items.quote: It's around -- planned to be around INR53 crores.

items.statement: Bhavnagar plant first project at 40-60% commercialization in FY24, targeting 100% in FY25
items.quote: '24-'25, we should be able to do 100%. This is approximately 50% of the total revenues, which were planned from these 2 projects or even more than that.

items.statement: Dahej site land in possession, EC application filed, plant commissioning 18-24 months after EC and parent approval
items.quote: I think definitely, after we get the environment clearance 18 months would be -- 18 months to 24 months would be the period.

items.statement: Bhavnagar 30-acre adjacent land purchased for tebuconazole expansion (1,000 tons/annum), timing depends on demand clarity
items.quote: This plot was taken to expand our tebuconazole facility because as you know, as we already have one plant of tebuconazole at Bhavnagar.

items.statement: FY24 gross margin 37.5%, Q4 at 42%; management believes normalized margins sustainable barring geopolitical supply shocks
items.quote: We believe that these 42% level margins are not abnormal margins. What we believe is this high cost inventory, which negatively impacted that was a one-off the event which negatively impacted us for, say, 1 or 2 quarters.

items.statement: Raw material packing material consumption down 3.5% in FY24; high-cost inventory liquidated by Aug 2023, low-cost inventory benefited margins
items.quote: So if you see over the period of the entire year, our raw material packing material consumption has come down by 3.5%.

items.statement: Green power capex to save ~2 crore units annually at INR4/unit vs grid purchase
items.quote: Well, it will be say around 2 crores units. Bhavya Gandhi: 2 crores? Chetan Shah: So we are buying just now about 90 lakhs -- 1.5 crores units, which we are buying from outside, we will save at least INR4 per unit

items.statement: Domestic demand sentiment slightly better than last year; farmers waiting for monsoon progress
items.quote: Compared to last year, the sentiments are good. The monsoon forecast is good. So there is not a significant pushback but it's also there is not a significant demand.

items.statement: LatAm export recovery gradual, positive signals but season not started; shipped Q4 FY24, good Q1 FY25 order position
items.quote: We have shipped out the materials in the fourth quarter also to Latin America. We have good order position in the first quarter, but we still have to have a little bit long-term view as to how this will pan out.

items.statement: FY25 launches: 3 proprietary 9(3) products (cotton, rice, vegetables) targeting Kharif; 1-2 more pending registration
items.quote: We already have received 3 registrations in the last couple of months. One is for cotton, one is for rice, one is for vegetables, you know insects as well as mites and also diseases in paddy.

items.statement: Parent pipeline focuses on long-life patented/leadership products, not commodities; advanced studies for Dahej products
items.quote: We are not looking at the products which could become off-patent or which could become commodity, where the margins could be under pressure.

items.statement: Working capital days improved substantially in FY24; may loosen inventory slightly for growth but sustain cash conversion gains
items.quote: We believe that whatever cash we have generated, some bit of the cash or large part of that cash will be deployed back in the business once the volume becomes normal.

items.statement: Future capex to be funded entirely from internal accruals, no external borrowing planned
items.quote: We are in a position to make that capex from our internal accruals. We are not going to borrow any money from outside for this capex.

items.statement: All parent transactions INR-denominated, exports USD-linked; no JPY exposure
items.quote: All our transaction with our parent company, none of the transactions are linked to the yen. All our purchase transactions on an INR basis and which we have clarified in the past also in some of the calls and on our export transactions are normally linked to U.S.

items.statement: Dahej EC application covers broad product list; final product selection awaits parent approval for 2 new patented molecules
items.quote: Out of that, what we'll pick up to actually manufacture will be these molecules, which we are awaiting the go-ahead from Japan.

items.statement: PGR (plant growth regulators) segment contributes ~10% of revenue, high growth globally and in India
items.quote: We have achieved about 10% of sales from this PGR segment, plant growth regulators and that is a very high growth segment all over the world and in India.

items.statement: Geopolitical risk: Taiwan route closure could disrupt China supply chain, increase transport cost and lead time
items.quote: Suppose if the Taiwan route closes down, the supply chain will be totally disrupted. And China will have to find a very long way of sort of a sea route to get the materials.

items.statement: No glyphosate exports to LatAm; African glyphosate volumes stable regardless of price cycles
items.quote: We don't supply glyphosate to LatAm at all. We supply glyphosate to African markets. We have large exports there. We don't see any problem in those markets.

items.statement: IT chemicals entry planned via Sumitomo Chemical India (no SPV); manufacturing in India long-term after market entry
items.quote: Initially, we want just an entry of Sumitomo IT chemicals into India. And this will not be through anybody, any third company or any outsider or it will be only from Sumitomo Chemical India within this company.

items.statement: Core operating revenue expected to grow at 20% CAGR over next 2 years backed by ongoing contracts
items.quote: So on the core operating front which is excluding IndAS looking at our tipping fee and sale of RDF we would be in the range of around 20% growth over the next 2 years backed fully by ongoing contracts.

items.statement: Core EBITDA margin guided at 22-24% going forward
items.quote: EBITDA margins will be in the range of around 22% to 24%.

items.statement: PAT margin guided at 10.5-11.25% going forward
items.quote: So we would be happy with the PAT margin of around 10.5% to 11.25% going forward.

items.statement: Group would be debt-free in 4 years if no new contracts won
items.quote: So if the company doesn't bag any contract or doesn't win any new waste-to-energy projects, the group would be debt-free in 4 years' time.

items.statement: Signed C&T contract worth INR386 crores for Panvel Municipal Corporation on asset-light model
items.quote: Among these, the company signed a contract worth approximately INR386 crores for its collection and transportation projects of municipal solid waste in Panvel Municipal Corporation.

items.statement: Secured CIDCO biomining contract valued at INR77 crores to process 8.6 lakh tons over 2 years
items.quote: Another new project in the processing phase was the company securing a biomining contract in CIDCO valued at approximately INR77 crores in which the company will process about 8.6 lakh tons of legacy waste over 2 years.

items.statement: Pursuing large Chennai waste processing tender with 20-year concession, 3000-4000 TPD capacity including 1400 TPD WTE
items.quote: So there is one ongoing tender which we are very seriously pursuing in the city of Chennai. I would not say it's just as a waste-to-energy because that's a very large waste processing you can say park which they have contemplated

items.statement: Vehicle scrapping venture capex ~INR20 crores on leased land (opex model)
items.quote: In terms of investments, we expec t an investment of about INR 20 crores to start with . That's the capex because we are not buying land , we have decided to go for leased land. So, it's going to be an opex item

items.statement: Tyre recycling venture capex ~INR5-7 crores depending on import volumes
items.quote: Tires also is going to be in the range of INR5 -INR6 crores, I mean, depending on how we proceed because we are going to import tires as well to make the project viable for some of the end applications.

items.statement: PCMC WTE plant achieved 71% PLF in inaugural quarter, targeting 80% stabilization
items.quote: The plant is running successfully since then and achieved an impressive plant-load factor of approximately 71% during its inaugural first quarter of operation. This marks a significant milestone, and the company aims to stabilize their performance at about 80% going forward.

items.statement: C&D plant in Mumbai successfully tested, commercial operations starting shortly
items.quote: I am pleased to inform that we have already successfully tested the C&D plant and it met all the performance parameter positively.

items.statement: CIDCO biomining site commercial operations to commence in Q1 FY25
items.quote: Additionally, we will commence commercial operations at the CIDCO Biomining Site in the first quarter of FY '25.

items.statement: Managed 4.67 million tons waste in FY24, up 12% YoY
items.quote: For the full year FY '24, we managed 4.67 million tons of waste, marking a 12% year-on-year increase.

items.statement: Core EBITDA grew 29% YoY to INR198 crores with 23% margin in FY24
items.quote: For FY '24, our core EBITDA amounted to INR198 crores, making a 29% year-over-year growth. With core EBITDA margin of 23%, which is again in line with our expectation.

items.statement: WTE revenue contribution still small vs C&T (~INR50 cr vs INR400+ cr), limiting margin uplift
items.quote: The reason the margins are likely to be inching up and not jumping is the contribution to the top-line. I mean, we will be looking at around INR 50 odd crores of revenue from the WTE, while my C&T business today is around INR400 plus crores.

items.statement: PCMC WTE tipping fee escalation due 12 months after COD (Oct 2023)
items.quote: So the tipping fee is as per the contract, I mean, it is fixed. So it only will have the first escalation 12 months after the COD.

items.statement: DSOs improved from 103 days (Mar 24) to 79 days after subsequent collections
items.quote: Adjusted for the collections made till date, our March 2024, DSOs would now stand at 79 days as against the 103 days mentioned in the presentation.

items.statement: Collected INR36 crores current receivables and INR15 crores old receivable in 45 days post March
items.quote: So we have realized around INR36-odd crores of the current receivables in the 45 days period. Additionally, we have received a large chunk to the tune of INR 15 crores from an old receivable.

items.statement: Gross debt INR414.6 crores, net debt INR343 crores, net debt/equity 0.5x, WACD 8.5%
items.value: INR414.6 crores gross, INR343 crores net
items.quote: As of March '24, the company's group debt stood at INR414.6 crores and net debt is at around INR343 crores indicating net debt to equity of around 0.5x. The weighted cost of debt for the group stands at around 8.5%.

items.statement: VGF grant of ~INR35 crores expected in weeks, to be used for debt repayment
items.quote: It should be in the range of around INR35-odd crores and that will go completely towards debt repayment.

items.statement: Vehicle scrapping policy in place (15 yr petrol, 10 yr diesel); Maharashtra license application underway
items.quote: Yes. That is 15 years for petrol vehicles, 10-years for the diesel vehicles. Different states have actually given a few years of flexibility to the retail customers.

items.statement: Income tax search claim of INR9 crores received, contesting via CIT appeal
items.quote: We have received a total claim from the authority amounting to INR9 crores. This represents about 9% of our annual profit for FY '24. Our dedicated team is diligently planning to contest this claim through CIT appeal.

items.statement: Finalized terms with top-5 FMCG multinational for rPET bottle collection (EPR-driven), starting in Mumbai
items.quote: So on this we are -- currently, we have sort of finalized one contract with a large FMCG multinational which wants us to source and process recycled PET bottles into rPET so that they can use it for their plastic requirement.

items.statement: RDF sales hit record 1.47 lakh tons in FY24, high calorific value substituting coal for cement
items.quote: During FY '24, we also achieved a record RDF sale of 1.47 lakh tons. This indicates that our RDF has a very high calorific value, making it suitable substitute for coal, thus aiding cement companies in meeting their alternative fuel requirement objectives.

items.statement: PCMC WTE project cost overrun to INR240 cr vs INR190 cr due to COVID, steel/cement inflation; tipping fee revision sought
items.quote: So normally, during the construction side, the company's project was hit by -- due to COVID. So there was a cost and a time overload. So that has kind of increased the cost due to cement and steel prices rising by around 32% and 38%, respectively.

items.statement: Deferred tax liability derecognized at AG Enviro Infra due to decision not to declare dividend amid ongoing capex
items.quote: we have tak en a call that the dividend will not be declared from the subsidiary, primarily because of the ongoing capex that is happening at the subsidiary level. So once you do an evaluation on this aspect, you don't have to have that deferred tax line item you get reversed

items.statement: FY25 order inflow target INR15,000-20,000 crores
items.quote: In FY'25, we will target at least INR15,000-INR20,000 crores.

items.statement: FY25 revenue expected to be flattish
items.quote: This year it will remain flattish.

items.statement: FY26 revenue growth target 15-20%
items.quote: For FY26 we are targeting a growth of 15% to 20% which is achievable.

items.statement: FY25 EBITDA margin expected around 13.5%
items.quote: Yes 13.5 around that.

items.statement: FY26 EBITDA margin expected to increase
items.quote: This year it will remain the same and next year it will definitely increase.

items.statement: Order book INR16,781 crores with executable INR9,735 crores as of March 2024
items.quote: As on 31st March '24, value of order book stood at INR16,781 crores out of which INR9,735 crores are executable order book.

items.statement: L1 for two Maharashtra EPC projects worth INR4,346 crores in May 2024
items.quote: In the month of May 2024, the company has also emerged as the lowest bidder for the two EPC road projects in the state of Maharashtra worth INR4,346 crores.

items.statement: Submitted bids for 12 highway and railway projects worth INR10,228 crores
items.quote: As on date, the company has submitted 12 highway and railway projects bids amounting to INR10,228 crores which are expected to be opened soon.

items.statement: Targeting INR5,000 crores non-road order inflow in FY25
items.quote: Non-road, we can say -- I mean, non-road, we include metro, right, tunnel, then power transmission. We are targeting at least INR5,000 crores.

items.statement: Order pipeline identified worth INR250,000 crores across sectors
items.quote: The company is targeting order pipeline worth INR250,000 crores in various sectors like highway, road tunnels, metro, power and transmission, railways and roadways, etcetera.

items.statement: Q4 FY24 EBITDA margin 17.69% vs 14.53% YoY
items.quote: The EBITDA margin for the current quarter stood at 17.69% as against 14.53% during quarter ended March 31, 2023.

items.statement: FY24 standalone EBITDA margin 14.58% vs 16.12% YoY
items.quote: Stand-alone EBITDA margin has decreased to 14.58% in the year ended March 2024 from 16.12% in the year ended March 2023.

items.statement: FY24 consolidated EBITDA margin 23.63% vs 26.93% YoY
items.quote: EBITDA margin at group level also decreased to 23.63% in fiscal 2024 from 26.93% in the year fiscal 2023.

items.statement: Non-road projects initial margins 10-15% improving with experience
items.quote: Non-road, maybe we are always targeting depend ing on competition, let's say in power and transmission, right? Because of competition, we can't have that kind of margin which we are always expecting in road, right? But as we are progressing, as we are developing our own strength in this particular sector, we will be increasing our margin with every project, right? So probably we can start with 10%

items.statement: FY24 capex INR108 crores
items.quote: During the year, company has made addition to the fixed asset amount of INR108 crores.

items.statement: FY25 capex target INR200-250 crores including office building
items.quote: We are targeting around INR200 crores to INR250-odd crores for the current year reason being INR100 crores will be -- INR150 crores, we will be putting in our office building.

items.statement: 28 BOT projects: 5 operational, 14 under construction, 9 awaiting appointed date
items.quote: As on the date, the company has a decent mix of 28 BOT projects of which 5 are operational, 14 under construction and 9 projects are awaiting appointed dates.

items.statement: Working capital days increased to 112 from 104 due to SPV debtors
items.quote: Our working capital in days at the end of current fiscal is 112 days as compared to 104 days at the end of fiscal 2023. This increase is primarily on account of increase in SPV debtors.

items.statement: Standalone debt INR739 crores, debt/equity 0.10x; consolidated debt INR3,803 crores, debt/equity 0.51x
items.quote: Our total stand-alone borrowing outstanding at the end of fiscal '24 is around INR739 crores with debt to equity of 0.10x. Total consolidated borrowing outstanding at the end of fiscal 2024 is INR3,803 crores with debt to equity of 0.51x.

items.statement: Consolidated debt reduced by INR3,533 crores due to InvIT transfer
items.quote: Our debt at console level has also reduced by INR3,533 crores due to this transaction.

items.statement: Transferred 7 HAM assets to Bharat Highways InvIT for 43.56% stake, gain INR1,372 crores
items.quote: During the quarter, the company has transferred 7 operational HEM assets to Bharat Highways InvIT in exchange of units in the InvIT which resulted into 43.56% stake in the InvIT. The result gained on the transaction has been shown as an exceptional item in financial statements.

items.statement: InvIT dividend INR3 per unit declared, expect INR60 crores dividend+interest
items.quote: This is the declaration they declared last year -- yesterday only INR3 per unit. So we'll be getting INR1,900-odd -- something-odd crores -- INR19-odd crores of units we are holding. So we'll be getting around INR60 crores of both including dividend and interest.

items.statement: Belgaum bypass HAM project terminated due to authority non-fulfilment
items.quote: One of our HEM projects, Belgavi bypass in the state of Karnataka having EPC value worth INR797 crores has been terminated due to non-fulfilment of condition presented by authority.

items.statement: Ludhiana-Rupnagar HAM project ROW issues, termination communicated, INR600-650 crores at risk
items.quote: NSA has not been able to provide requisite index-free ROW for construction work in one of our HEM projects in the state of Punjab and hence we have communicated our intention to terminate the project. The response of authority is still awaited.

items.statement: Equity investment balance INR2,137 crores for HAM portfolio, INR800-850 crores in FY25
items.quote: Balance promoter contribution or equity contribution required to be made for our operational or yet to start HAM project is INR2,137 crores, of which we are expecting contribution of INR800 crores to INR850 crores in the current financial year.

items.statement: Management targets minimum 30% revenue growth for FY25
items.quote: So, financially, for FY '25, we are looking at a minimum of 30% growth, sir, to drive that. So, that is what we are looking at the minimum number to drive that.

items.statement: Domestic sales grew 26.47% in FY24
items.quote: Let me begin by highlighting our domestic sales growth which has surged by an impressive 26.47% in the current financial year compared to the preceding year.

items.statement: Export margins are 10-12% higher than domestic margins
items.quote: Yes, yes. Approximately about 10%-12% difference.

items.statement: Export revenue grew 5% in FY24
items.quote: There was about 5% growth in the exports in this financial year, in the last financial year.

items.statement: Current capacity utilization is 45% with 55% unutilized capacity
items.quote: Our current capacity utilization stands at 45% for the existing product line, indicating that we still have 55% unutilized capacity.

items.statement: Maximum capital expenditure has been incurred; new R&D setup and additional line of activity completed
items.quote: Now that the maximum capital expenditure has been incurred. We are confident that our capital expenditure will be beneficial for us in the forthcoming period and our margins may increase positively impacting our net profitability.

items.statement: Oradox oral care brand launched with promising response; disinfectant line ready for commercial launch
items.quote: Our new segment oral care under the brand name Oradox has shown promising response since its inception. The positive r esponse from our stakeholders reaffirms our confidence that Oradox will significantly contribute to our top line in the post-semi-period

items.statement: India revenue share is 42-44% in FY24; targeting increase going forward
items.quote: Currently, it is around 42 % to 44%. So, it is somewhere between that in the current last financial year in terms of the Indian market percentage contribution. And since our market, since we are having some exports, we look at it increasing the contribution going forward.

items.statement: US export share grew from 2.87% to 3.6% in FY24; targeting growth in US, UK, Australia, Canada, Brazil
items.quote: Already our business has grown from 2.87% last year to 3.6%. So, like that, we are very positive for the business growth in the U.S. market and other developed countries.

items.statement: Debtor days increased from 32 to 53 days due to LC and CAD terms in export markets with forex crunch
items.quote: Export, as we already Mr. Modi is saying that because of cash crunch in African countries and a few European countries also, we are working on LC, letter of credit. So the period is increasing. Before that, we were taking advance payment from those countries. Now they are giving us letter of credit. And the other thing, they are giving cash against documents, CAD.

items.statement: Company holds INR28-48 crores cash; evaluating inorganic acquisition opportunities outside India
items.quote: We are looking at different opportunities, options to invest with this cash reserve. So we are looking at opportunity to invest or acquire some companies so that we can have some inorganic growth.

items.statement: Actively evaluating acquisition targets outside India, primarily in US market; due diligence ongoing
items.quote: We have options to acquire companies outside India also. So we are working on that strategy to acquire a company outside India. If there is no good company available in India, we look at the opportunity to acquire some business, running business in the U.S. market or in any other country.

items.statement: Paid 10% dividend in FY24; will consider continuing dividend policy for FY25
items.quote: Last year we gave 10% dividend, but this year also we'll take a positive look at that, and we will continue, hopefully. So we have not yet decided, but definitely we'll be considering the option of continuing the dividend policy.

items.statement: Employee count grew 78% in FY24 across manufacturing, R&D, sales, marketing and administration
items.quote: As the employees have been added in the manufacturing, in the research and in the sales and marketing because the new product line order has been started commercially. So we have to hire people to run the plant.

items.statement: Prevest Research Centre received Ministry of Science and Technology approval; first Indian dental company with government-recognized research centre
items.quote: Prevest Research Centre has received approval from the Ministry of Science and Technology. Prevest DenPro is the first dental company of India who has set up state-of-the-art research centre that has been recognized by the Government of India.

items.statement: Online channel contributes 8-10% of India revenue in FY24
items.quote: If I could throw a number, maybe around 8% to 10%.

items.statement: Export challenges in African and South American countries due to foreign exchange shortages; buyers unable to remit payments
items.quote: the major challenges we are facing for the exports are in some African countries and South American countries. So, these are the two continents where we have not been able to grow. But we have been able to maintain the same level of exports. But we have not been able to grow in these countries because of the currency constraints. You know, these countries are deprived of the foreign exchange. So,

items.statement: Proprietary formulations and government-approved R&D centre create high entry barriers; limited competition in specialized dental materials
items.quote: The products which we manufacture are very technical products. The formulations have been developed in -house with our own internal research and development efforts. items.statement: R&D expenditure was INR8 crores in FY24; exhibition and marketing spend INR2.19 crores
items.quote: Our expenditure in R&D department was around 8 crores for the financial year 2013-2014. In addition to these expenditures, we do have expenditures in terms of exhibition and marketing which is around, say, INR2.19 crores.

items.statement: 3D resin sales started with positive response in India and exports; expect strong growth in FY25
items.quote: 3D resin, already we have started the marketing and the response is very positive in India as well as outside India. So the response is very good. We have already started the sales and the business is growing. And in this financial year, we will do very good in the 3D resin business also.

items.statement: Paid off Rs. 156.5 crores debt in FY24, achieving net debt-free status
items.quote: The company paid off debts amounting to Rs. 156.5 crores in FY24, reaching a net debt-free status during the year.

items.statement: Working capital cycle reduced from 108 days in FY23 to 79 days in FY24
items.quote: We also saw a notable reduction in our working capital cycle, cutting it down from 108 days in FY23 Sanjay Chhabra: Moderator: Videesha Sheth: to 79 days in FY24, thanks to decreased inventory levels and a deliberate effort to reduce the receivable

items.statement: Aspire to maintain EBITDA margins in 17%-19% range
items.quote: So going forward, certainly we'll aspire to maintain our margins in the range of, | would say, 17% to 19% EBITDA levels that is the aspiration, and even in this quarter four, we've delivered at 18.3

items.statement: Plan to open 80-100 EBO stores annually from FY25 onwards, mostly FOFO model
items.quote: But going forward, as we see better visibility and | would say, BIS impact also coming in, we would certainly like to get back on track in terms of opening about 80 to 100 stores from FY25 onwards again, most of which would be FOFO

items.statement: North and West regions grew ~10% YoY in Q4; UP, Bihar, Maharashtra improved 20%, 14%, 10% respectively
items.quote: So during the quarter, right, so we've seen increase in our North and West business by almost like a 10% increase year-on-year. And the other regions have sort of been flattish, like East and Central and South have more or less been flat.

items.statement: Launched comprehensive portfolio across all price points from Rs. 799 to Rs. 2,999 to address rural demand
items.quote: So, as of today, we have basically launched a complete and very comprehensive portfolio of designs catering from all price points starting at 799 going up to as high as 2,999.

items.statement: Premiumization slowed; focusing on economical portfolio (Rs. 899-1000 MRP) to drive volume and operating leverage
items.quote: Therefore, we've pivoted to the strategy of increasing our economical portfolio as well. That is from 899, basically up to 1000 bucks MRP. So that would definitely give us additional volume.

items.statement: Trade distribution grew 7.5% in Q4; D2C declined 6% due to B2B/O2O degrowth offset by marketplace growth of 32%
items.quote: So we've seen about 7.5% growth in terms of value in our trade channels in Quarter 4. And this is primarily due to these two or three initiatives that we have quite aggressively run.

items.statement: BIS norms require non-BIS inventory upload by Aug 1, 2024 and liquidation by June 1, 2025; expect limited short-term impact
items.quote: Because the BIS norms dictate that we need to upload the non-BIS inventory onto the portal by 1st of August this year, and the government has given time till 1st of June 2025 to liquidate all non-BIS goods.

items.statement: Gross margin compressed ~1.5% YoY and QoQ due to online commission rebates passed as lower ASP and Rs. 1.6 crore NRV hit
items.quote: That has resulted in around 1% lower gross margin. Apart from that, we have taken a one-time NRV hit of roughly Rs. 1.6 crores. So our COGS have gone up to that extent, and that has also resulted in a drop of roughly 40 basis points.

items.statement: A&P spend at ~7% of revenue in FY24; plan to continue at 6-7% range
items.quote: We have been trending at about 7% A&P spend this year FY24. We do not foresee any reduction in that at the moment. So we'll probably continue to spend in the range of 6% to 7% for sure.

items.statement: Integrated supply chain with 60-65 days lead time from sourcing to product launch; design IP protection in place
items.quote: So it's not easy for anyone to replicate in terms of the lead time, especially that we offer. This is the shortest, and we still trend at about 60 to 65 days of lead time from, let's say, sourcing to product launch.

items.statement: Channel inventory fairly in control; no concerning elevation except maybe one or two areas
items.quote: It is fairly in control. We don't see barring maybe just one or two areas, which is not very concerning. We are fairly comfortable in terms of channel inventory at the moment.

items.statement: D2C DSO improved ~50% due to channel shift from B2B/O2O to marketplace (21-30 days vs 45-60 days for distribution)
items.quote: So that shift in channel from B2B, 020 to marketplace has resulted in a D2C DSO improving by at least 50%. And that's what has got reflected in the overall DSOs

items.statement: Net debt reduced from ~Rs. 180 crores to ~Rs. 24 crores; achieved net debt-free status in FY24
items.quote: We have seen a significant decrease in the net debt from around Rs. 180 crores to around Rs. 24 crores as at end of FY24. I'm happy to state that we have achieved the net debt free status in FY24.

items.statement: Macro trends average; not too bad, not too great; Q1 and Q2 are seasonally smaller quarters
items.quote: The macro trends at the moment seem normal. | mean, they're not too bad and not too great. They're pretty average. And also, this is really not the main season time for us as a brand

items.statement: Confident of returning to double-digit and mid-teen growth if macros remain stable; not providing specific numbers
items.quote: So we do have a good visibility in terms of getting there sooner than later. The only question remains again is in terms of macros, as long as they remain stable and not too volatile or too depressed.

items.statement: Marketplace business salience increased across Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra; offset O2O business loss
items.quote: both Amazon and Flipkart, which are the largest portals in the country have done very, very well for the brand. Therefore, the marketplace business salience, | would say has gone up across both these platforms

items.statement: Online commission rebates during campaigns passed on as lower ASP, causing ~1% gross margin impact
items.quote: During campaigns, we got certain rebates on online commission and we did pass on a part of that through lower ASP for the D2C channel. That has resulted in around 1% lower gross margin.

items.statement: Digital/performance marketing spend ~Rs. 60 crores out of ~Rs. 100 crores total A&P in FY24
items.quote: By digital spend, if you mean the performance marketing spend, that would be roughly around Rs. 60 odd crores.

items.statement: B2B/O2O online revenue halved from ~Rs. 300 crores in FY23 to ~Rs. 160 crores in FY24
items.quote: That number has come down to half. It was roughly Rs. 300 odd crores last year, which is in the range of Rs. 160 crores this year.

items.statement: EBO count reached 268 by end of FY24; added 66 new stores in western, southern, eastern regions
items.quote: Campus Activewear further widens its presence across India by inaugurating 66 new stores in the western, southern and eastern regions, bringing the total number of exclusive brand outlets to 268 by the end of the year.

items.statement: Channel-specific portfolio strategy: segregated online/offline portfolios; EBO carries common portfolio; LFS has separate portfolio
items.quote: So portfolio is specific to each channel. So we don't have a common portfolio anymore. There is no conflict, especially between the online and GTM, between GT.

items.statement: Other expenses declined 17% YoY due to lower factory overheads, front-loaded A&P in Q3, and online commission rebates
items.quote: Other expenses primarily are a subset of three big buckets. One is our factory overheads plus freight and then the admin SG&A and also the advertisement and promotion spend. So you see dip versus last year it's a combination of again three things.

items.statement: Rural demand subdued in Q2-Q3 FY24; portfolio optimization across price points giving momentum
items.quote: Rural demand, we have definitely seen a fair share of subdued demand over the year, especially in quarter two and some bit in quarter three. But with our renewed focus towards certain strategies that we have implemented including portfolio optimization.

items.statement: Aspire to maintain and grow business from current levels; focus on 3-4 major initiatives aligned across functions
items.quote: We believe the company is definitely back on track with all the right initiatives in place, which are being, you can see it from the balance sheet position, which is the best basically that we've ever seen in the history of the company.

items.statement: Target Banca channel share of 5-6% of total business from current 3.61%
items.quote: We want to grow at least 5-6% from present 3.61% share of Banca to total our business. So, that will grow at least 5%, 6%. That is our target for Banca.

items.statement: Non-Par APE share doubled to 18.32% in FY24 from 8.89% in FY23
items.quote: I am sure that you are noticing the more than doubling of the individual Non Par APE share from INR 3,436 crore to INR 7,041 crore and from 8.89% to 18.32% which has been the outcome of our intense focus on enhancing Non Par business.

items.statement: VNB grew 4.66% YoY to INR 9,583 crore with margin expanding 60 bps to 16.8%
items.quote: Value of New Business (VNB) is INR 9,583 crore for the year ended March 31st 2024 as compared to VNB of INR 9,156 crore for the year ended March 31st 2023. As you can see the VNB has registered an increase of 4.66% on year on year basis. Further, the net VNB margin for FY24 is 16.8% as compared to 16.2% for year ended March 31st 2023. Hence, the VNB margin has expanded by 60 basis points on a year

items.statement: Indian Embedded Value grew 24.92% YoY to INR 7,27,344 crore
items.quote: The IEV of the Corporation has been determined as Rs. 7,27,344 crore as at March 31st 2024 as compared to Rs. 5,82,243 crore as at March 31st, 2023. Therefore the IEV has grown by 24.92% on a year on year basis.

items.statement: Assets Under Management grew 16.48% YoY to INR 51,21,887 crore
items.quote: Assets under Management as on 31st March 2024 grew by 16.48% year on year to INR 51,21,887 crore as compared to INR 43,97,205 crore as on March 31st 2023.

items.statement: Solvency ratio improved to 1.98 from 1.87
items.quote: The Solvency Ratio as on March 31st 2024 improved to 1.98 as against 1.87 on March 31st 2023.

items.statement: PAR and Group VNB margins declined due to risk-free rate movement and annuity benefit enhancements
items.quote: As regards the margins, yes, the margins under PAR and group had fallen mainly because of the movement in the risk-free rates. And in the case of group, the benefit enhancement done in the annuities is the major cause of it.

items.statement: ANANDA app policies grew 42.84% YoY to 11.59 lakh, crossing 1 million mark
items.quote: In our digital initiative through the Agent assisted ANANDA app, we have completed 11,58,805 policies through this App during the year ended March 31st 2024 as compared to 8,11,278 policies for the comparable period ending March 31st 2023 thereby registering a growth of 42.84% on year-on-year basis. It is a matter of extreme pride that we have comfortably crossed one million policies mark over ANA

items.quote: I would like to share that the Board has recommended a Final Dividend of Rs. 6/- per share in its meeting held on 27th May, 2024, subject to shareholders approval. This is in addition to Rs. 4/- per share interim dividend that was declared and paid earlier during the year.

items.statement: Exploring inorganic growth in health insurance via stake acquisition in standalone health insurer; no merger with non-life PSUs
items.quote: No, no, there is no such proposal for merging with taking in non-life PSU companies, but we will definitely explore possibilities to have some stake in some standalone health insurance company, something like that. That also we are working on that.

items.quote: So far as this regulation is concerned, we as insurance companies, we have placed before regulator our views. Discussion is going on. Some final outcome will come which will be in the best interest of customers as well as industry. So, that is going on still now. Nothing finalized

items.quote: This year we have taken a target; we should represent every panchayat. Every panchayat in the country must have one LIC agent at least. So, that is the target for the current year and in that direction we have already started.

items.quote: Hence, persistency has improved for 13th, 25th and 49th month, year on year, both on premium basis and number of policies basis.

items.statement: Profit After Tax INR 40,676 crore including INR 29,518.75 crore transfer from Non-Par ASM accretions

items.statement: Overall expense ratio marginally up 4 bps to 15.57%
items.quote: Our Overall Expense Ratio stands at 15.57% for the year ended March 31st 2024, as compared to 15.53% for the same period of last year. As you can see, the increase is a marginal 4 bps on year-on-year basis.

items.statement: Death claims down 3.41% to INR 22,625 crore; maturity claims up 12.48% to INR 2,08,136 crore
items.quote: On an amount basis during FY24, the maturity claims were INR 2,08,136 crore and the death claims were INR 22,625 crores. On a comparable basis for FY23, the maturity claims were INR 1,85,044 crore and death claims were INR 23,423 crore. Therefore, the death claims are lower by 3.41% and the maturity claims are higher by 12.48% on a year-on-year basis.

items.statement: Revenue to grow at ~20% CAGR for next 3 years; Gross Margin maintained at 11-13%
items.quote: Given the macro development of the credit card industry, the higher base of the business model and ever-changing industry scenario, we estimate that our Revenues would grow at an approximate 20% CAGR for the next 3 years and maintain Gross Margins in the range of 11% to 13%.

items.statement: FY24 Gross Margin 12.1% within 11-13% guidance; Adjusted EBITDA margin 9.1%
items.quote: For the full year, our Gross Margins were at 12.1%, in line with the guidance of 11% -13%. Our Adjusted EBITDA, adjusted for non-cash ESOP expenses was at INR103 crores with a margin of 9.1% during the year.

items.statement: Q4 FY24 Gross Margin 12.5%; Adjusted EBITDA margin 9.7%, up 226 bps from Q1
items.quote: The company's Revenue from Operations for the quarter stood at INR281 crores in Q4FY24 against INR238 crores in Q4FY23, registering a growth of 18.2% Y-o-Y. Gross Profit was at INR35 crores, while Gross Margin was at 12.5% for the quarter. The Adjusted EBITDA stood at INR27 crores with an Adjusted Margin of 9.7%.

items.statement: Facilitated ~11M pax in FY24 vs 8.2M in FY23; digital tools contribute 10% of monthly pax
items.quote: We facilitated approximately 11 million pax this year, which was 3.5 million in FY22 and 8.2 million in the previous year. We saw a significant increase in adoption of digital tools like web-access and self-check-in kiosks contributing to 10% of our monthly paxes.

items.statement: Non-India airport lounge services now 6% of revenue (up from <2% in FY22); target 15-20% in 4-5 years
items.quote: The services other than the Indian airport lounge now contribute 6% to our Revenue, which was less than 2% in FY22. We remain focused on increasing the contribution of these services and expect these services to contribute around 15% to 20% in the next 4 to 5 years.

items.statement: Diversifying client base via OTAs, airlines, enterprises; hired 16 management trainees from top institutes
items.quote: Our new go-to-market strategy involves partnerships with OTAs, airlines and enterprises. This strategic pivot is designed to broaden our market reach and of course, increase the brand equity of Dream Folks among different set of clients. To spearhead this diversification, we have recruited 16 talented professionals from the top business schools and engineering colleges of India.

items.statement: Asset-light model; no major capex; cloud-based proprietary tech platform developed in-house
items.quote: In line with our commitment to maintain an asset-light and lean organisational structure, our cloud-based platform provides clients and the consumers with clear visibility into benefits and services.

items.statement: Spend-based transition ongoing; 2-3 large clients yet to implement; volumes to stabilize by Q3 FY25
items.quote: In the coming quarter, we see that 2 or 3 large clients, we have already got the dates in terms of the spend-based solution that they have adopted, and we are still yet to see the volumes that will get impacted. To my mind, I think we will see through this in Q3 probably. So, the volume will stabilize in Q3.

items.statement: Board recommended final dividend INR1.5/share; interim INR0.50 in Q1 FY24; total 100% of face value
items.quote: Further, I'm happy to share with you that our Board has recommended a final dividend of INR1.5 per share for FY24. We had paid an interim dividend of INR0.50 in Q1FY24, which takes our annual dividend to 100% of the face value.

items.statement: Actively seeking synergistic acquisition opportunities; accumulated cash flows to be utilized
items.quote: We are also very active in terms of finding out new synergistic opportunities for acquisitions and that's where the accumulated cash flow, which we are generating would get utilized.

items.statement: Global lounge industry expected to grow at 7.5% CAGR (2023-2033); Asia Pacific fastest growing market
items.quote: Estimates indicate that the global lounge industry is expected to grow at a CAGR of 7.5% from 2023 to 2033 as per Spherical Insights report from Jan '24. On a global level, Asia Pacific is expected to be the fastest-growing market driven by significant increase in air traffic and investments in aviation infrastructure.

items.statement: Global pricing behind competitors currently; expect to match India-level commercials once volumes build in international markets
items.quote: So, as I told you, Shreyans, that the way we are actually today enjoying in India market, the best of the commercial s compared to the competitor. So obviously, in the global market, we are a little behind than the competition. I think once we start building the volumes there, then we would enjoy the best of the commercial even for those lounges

items.quote: we are now reassessing that and probably in a couple of months we would be in a more clear position on what type of top line growth are we be looking at for the current financial year

items.statement: Q1 FY25 revenue expected to be sequentially flattish vs Q4 FY24
items.quote: Q1 could be sequentially broadly flattish in that range

items.statement: Medium-term EBITDA margin target remains 20-21%
items.quote: definitely our medium-term target is to get back to 20% to 21%

items.statement: New business awards at INR 175-200 crores for FY25 (Year 0 and Year 1), but implementation timelines may shift
items.quote: new business, that is right in the range of INR175 crores to INR200 crores is the number that we are expecting in the current year which includes the year 0 and year 1 what we call it

items.quote: early signals of slowdown in US large ag, as indicated in the previous 2 quarters, have started to materialize and expect it to have adverse impact on demand vis-a-vis FY '24

items.quote: On the construction side of the end market, the U.S. market for us is steady with new business driven by China plus 1 and US Infrastructure Bill. Europe is witnessing slight softness, while Japan is largely steady

items.quote: EBITDA margin reported at 17.8% for the quarter 4 and 18.5% for the full year FY '24, respectively

items.quote: The capex for this year is about INR40 crores plan. Normally we do 2.5% of the sales, but certain new projects which we have bagged as a company we expect the INR40 crores to be used as a capex at least

items.quote: the last year closed at around 60% level. I mean this is a broader approximation, a little here or there. And so there is adequate headroom as far as normal products are concerned

items.quote: the top 10 customers are about 76%, 77%. Top 5 are closer to in the 55% to 60% range all put together

items.quote: just 2 weeks ago, they have approved us for that, and they say, this is another area that is going to open up for us to give you knew business

items.quote: Net working capital comprising of big 3 elements of inventory, accounts receivable and account payable, as number of days of trailing 12-month revenue from operations stood at 152 days as on 31st March 2024. items.statement: Actively evaluating inorganic acquisitions in hydraulics, PTOs to leverage dual-shore model; made headway but more work needed

items.quote: our Vizag facility is now equipped with captive rooftop solar plant, while our Noida facilities are in the process of getting open access solar power supply

items.quote: Macro concerns over global economic slowdown, geopolitical uncertainties and impact of worldwide high interest rate continues to remain a key monitorable

items.statement: FY24 EBITDA down to Rs 406m from Rs 651m due to negative operating leverage
items.quote: For the full year FY24 EBITDA was Rs. 406 million against Rs. 651 million in FY23. On a full year basis, EBITDA has been impacted by negative operating leverage as revenue has declined marginally and costs have increased.

items.statement: FY24 capex Rs 200m for plant, machinery, tools and moulds
items.quote: Our CAPEX in Q4 FY24 was Rs. 56 million and in full year 24 was Rs. 200 million. This is largely on account of addition to plant and machinery and tools and moulds which are necessary for new product addition, and which will contribute to growth in the coming year.
